audience: accounting teams and ERP admins who send e-invoices over Peppol

useCases.title: Check whether a company can receive Peppol e-invoices
useCases.text: Look up the company by its VAT or company number. See whether it can receive e-invoices and which document types it accepts.

useCases.title: Look up a sending company and its administrations
useCases.text: Open a legal entity by its ID to see its Peppol identifiers and settings. Then open one of its administrations, such as the one that receives documents.

useCases.title: Track the delivery of a sent invoice
useCases.text: Read the sending or clearing evidence of a submitted document by its guid. Check it to confirm the delivery status.

useCases.title: Read a received purchase invoice
useCases.text: Open a received purchase invoice in JSON form by its guid, such as the guid from a webhook. Review its fields.

useCases.title: Send an invoice to a Peppol recipient
useCases.text: After the user confirms the recipient and the invoice, send a UBL or CII file over Peppol. Then read the delivery evidence. Sending cannot be undone.
